Scottsdale to downtown Tucson

Downtown Tucson (85701) is the cultural heart of Arizona's second-largest city, featuring UNESCO City of Gastronomy cuisine, vibrant arts scene, historic architecture, and unique Southwestern character. Located 2 hours south of Phoenix, Tucson offers a distinct personality with Mexican heritage, university culture, and desert sophistication. Our transportation connects Phoenix travelers to Tucson's many attractions.
